notes.title: Contra: Operation Galuga Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/765970/a74f001253d8ac024c37fb7be8a015c75d891186.png[/img]
Contra is back - reloaded, reimagined, and reborn - with Contra: Operation Galuga! Grab your spread shot and run 'n' gun your way through explosive co-op action against the Red Falcon army! 

This thorough remake of the revolutionary Contra NES/arcade game from the 1980s redeploys players to the Galuga Archipelago, where you'll take control of elite Contra commandos Bill Rizer and Lance Bean (as well as other warriors) and use an assortment of iconic weapons such as the Spread Shot, Laser Beam, and Homing Missiles to run, jump, and shoot your way through burning jungles, frigid mountains, a grotesque alien lair, and more. Character-specific abilities, devastating Overload powers, and unyielding bosses keep the action intense across Story Mode (1-2 players), Arcade Mode (1-4 players), and Challenge Mode (1 player), while variable difficulty settings and perks provide options for gamers of all skill levels!

Contra: Operation Galuga is available now!

notes.title: Contra: Operation Galuga Launches March 12!
notes.notes: Prepare to attack aggressively! The iconic run-'n'-gun series, Contra, is back - reloaded, reimagined, and reborn - with Contra: Operation Galuga, launching on March 12! The legendary soldiers return to blast their way through eight stages of action against the Red Falcon army in explosive co-op action for up to two players in Story Mode or up to four players in Arcade Mode!

notes.title: Dawn of the Monsters Downloadable Content
notes.notes:
Patch 1.2 for Dawn of the Monsters has arrived, bringing the long-awaited Arcade Edition DLC pack, as well as a ton of new free content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41455629/57888cb65fb11e0a3d4042157e4f6c5308ebc19b.png[/img]

[h2]Arcade Edition DLC pack[/h2]
[list]
[*] Play as the new character [b]Meteor Temujin[/b] in any mode
[*] Experience the [b]Arcade Mode[/b] and aim for the highest leaderboards
[*] Unlock new [b]Gallery[/b] and [b]Archive[/b] files, and glimpse the future of DotM
[/list]

[h2]Free update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenge yourself with 10 unique [b]Trials[/b]
[*] Play the story with a higher difficulty in the [b]New Game+[/b] mode
[*] Play with [b]Japanese[/b] text and/or voice-acting
[/list]

Learn more about the new content on the 13am Games website below.
https://www.13amgames.com/dotm-dlc1

notes.title: Dawn of the Monsters Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added internal challenge system! View your currently unlocked challenges in the Main Menu!
[*] Added a Restart Mission button! No more backing out all the way to the Command Center just to start a level over!
[*] Added a warning popup in the Chat menu explaining that chats expire
[*] Adjusted some text visuals for readability
[*] Fixed an issue where the loot pool would pull from historical best instead of your actual mission results
[*] Added Health readout to the inventory
[*] Updated the credits
[*] Fixed Monster Mash description
[*] Fixed an issue where the training grounds wouldn't fully refill your rage if you have more than 5 bars.
[*] Fixed display issues with telegraphs in Agnitor's fights
[/list]
